mechanism: Prochlorperazine and triamcinolone both increase risk of gastrointestinal ulceration and bleeding, and corticosteroids may potentiate anticholinergic effects of phenothiazines while increasing CNS depression.
action: Monitor for gastrointestinal symptoms; consider gastroprotection if combination is necessary; use lowest effective doses and shortest duration; assess for additive CNS and anticholinergic effects.
